.zak-ai-cmd-overlay          /* Full-screen backdrop */
.zak-ai-cmd-modal            /* Command palette modal */

.zak-ai-cmd-list             /* Scrollable command list */
.zak-ai-cmd-category         /* Category heading */
.zak-ai-cmd-item             /* Individual command row */
.zak-ai-cmd-item.active      /* Keyboard-focused item */
.zak-ai-cmd-item-icon        /* Command icon */
.zak-ai-cmd-item-icon.ai     /* AI icon (purple) */
.zak-ai-cmd-item-icon.action /* Action icon (green) */
.zak-ai-cmd-item-icon.nav    /* Navigation icon (amber) */
.zak-ai-cmd-item-text        /* Command label */
.zak-ai-cmd-item-desc        /* Command description */
.zak-ai-cmd-item-shortcut    /* Keyboard shortcut keys */
.zak-ai-cmd-footer           /* Footer with navigation hints */
.zak-ai-cmd-recent           /* Recent commands label */

JavaScript

Keyboard shortcut to open, search filtering, and keyboard navigation.

HTML
const overlay = document.getElementById('cmd-demo');
const input = document.getElementById('cmd-input-demo');
const list = document.getElementById('cmd-list-demo');
const items = list?.querySelectorAll('.zak-ai-cmd-item') || [];
let activeIndex = 0;

// Open with Cmd+K / Ctrl+K
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        overlay?.classList.toggle('show');
        if (overlay?.classList.contains('show')) input?.focus();
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') overlay?.classList.remove('show');
});

// Close on backdrop click
overlay?.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (e.target === overlay) overlay.classList.remove('show');
});

// Search filtering
input?.addEventListener('input', function() {
    const query = this.value.toLowerCase();
    items.forEach(item => {
        const search = (item.dataset.search || item.textContent).toLowerCase();
        item.style.display = search.includes(query) ? '' : 'none';
    });
    activeIndex = 0;
    updateActive();
});

// Keyboard navigation
input?.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    const visible = [...items].filter(i => i.style.display !== 'none');
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { activeIndex = Math.min(activeIndex + 1, visible.length - 1); updateActive(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { activeIndex = Math.max(activeIndex - 1, 0); updateActive(); }
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && visible[activeIndex]) visible[activeIndex].click();
});

function updateActive() {
    const visible = [...items].filter(i => i.style.display !== 'none');
    items.forEach(i => i.classList.remove('active'));
    if (visible[activeIndex]) visible[activeIndex].classList.add('active');
}

// Close on item click
items.forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
        overlay?.classList.remove('show');
        console.log('Selected:', item.querySelector('.zak-ai-cmd-item-text')?.textContent);
    });
});
Press ↑↓ to navigate Press ESC to close
